configuration: GPU0, FP32, batch1, four CPU threads and four-CPU affinity, official model preprocessing, no HPI/TensorRT/MKLDNN; 180-second external timer per process
sharing_authorization: Shared use permitted when capacity is available
capacity_policy: Before each crop: >=4096 MiB GPU free and <=10% utilization; otherwise defer without invoking. This is a run safety rule, not a storage budget or quality tuning.
isolation: Persistent writes root-only, plus explicitly authorized own-process task metadata; see isolation-amendment.json. Each neural worker installs its own Landlock ruleset; audited stdlib supervisors write only owned logs.
storage_policy: Measure actual allocation and filesystem availability; no arbitrary cap/reserve. No user cleanup to make room.
stop_policy: First crop attn_fraction, remaining seven only after actual RETURNED result. Stop on failed process/timeout/nonreturned result/unverified exit or resource conflict. No model retry or tuning.
model_input_policy: Only eight frozen PNGs, scripts and identity manifests. References/annotations/PDFs remain on client.
evaluation_policy: Reuse PR26 component inventory and PR27 comparison policy; exact/line-ending+strip comparisons are spelling checks, not mathematical equivalence. Alpha-reference discrepancy remains unscoreable.
hardware_caveat: New PP RTX5000Ada/FP32/CUDA12.6 differs from preserved CodeFormula T4/FP16/CUDA13; latency is observational, not controlled model speed ranking.
remote_cleanup: Only after verified archive and member hashes, exact identity/owner/filesystem/open-handle/process checks; descriptor-relative traversal without following symlinks; never another tree.
